fit_against_record_wording.record_text: لست اشكو الزمان اذ جاد منك بدر من بحر علم تدفق

verdict: partly consistent: 38 signs = 38 letters, 12 groups = 12 words once لي is read after جاد (the cipher has it; the reply verse 51v.9 has جاد لي منك too); the Ч-shapes break: the right-long Ч writes ب twice and the ل of الزمان, the left-long Ч the ل of لي and علم, a third shape ϟ the ل of لست
notes: Rows 5-7 of image 0084_0106. By eye 15 + 13 + 10 = 38 signs (record 14,13,10 = 37: it missed one on l.5), dividers after every word, 12 groups. The record's plaintext lacks لي: l.6 has a two-sign group (Ll Is) between جاد and منك; the reply verse (51v.9, كيف لا اشكر دهرا جاد لي منك بحبر) turns this one round with the same جاد لي منك, so the record's line dropped the word. ل has three shapes and the right-long Ч is shared with ب (montage m_I_ch.png): either the encipherer used near-identical Ч forms for ل and ب, or the small difference between right-long and left-long Ч is not a key distinction; by shape, 2 of the 3 Lr occurrences take ب. ز (Ib, curved top bar) and ي (Is, straight top bar) are near twins too. د and ذ are near twins (Lt plain <, Cc < with a hook).
